chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Ismāʿīl ibn Saʿd al-Ashʿarī, said:
I asked him about a garment of silk: may a man perform salat (prayer) in it? He said: No.

key_terms.الثَّوْبِ: a garment or piece of clothing
key_terms.لَا: a direct negation indicating prohibition or non-permissibility in context

ai.seo_question: Can a man perform salat (prayer) while wearing a silk garment?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding salat (prayer) in a garment made of silk. The Imam عليه السلام answers plainly that a man should not perform salat (prayer) in such a garment, which fits the chapter on the reprehensibility of praying in pure silk.
